intro: Ishamuhale's Fang is a hunting trophy taken from Ishamuhale, the notorious sunscale raptor known as Speartooth in the Barrens. Brought to Jorn Skyseer at Camp Taurajo, the tooth serves as proof of besting one of Kalimdor's deadliest natural predators.

p: Ishamuhale is feared across the central savanna as the fiercest sunscale raptor alive, an apex hunter said to kill purely out of predatory passion rather than mere hunger. Lured into the open with fresh zhevra meat beside a withered tree northwest of Ratchet, the beast offers no quarter. Severing its massive fang proves to the hunting instructors of the Horde that a traveler has conquered not just a beast, but the sheer savagery of the plains.
